basic_info.description: Elegant, charming Edwardian flat in the heart of San Francisco's prestigious Pacific Heights. This 1,500-square-foot residence offers a perfect blend of classic elegance and modern convenience. Step into an inviting space adorned with high ceilings, decorative vintage wood working and built-ins providing both functionality and style. The expansive living and dining rooms feature fireplaces and bay windows flooding the space with natural light creating a warm and welcoming ambiance. Two spacious bedrooms offer ample space for rest and rejuvenation. The kitchen boasts new countertops, a Thermador range, lots of storage, and an office space leading to a laundry/storage/work-room. The building is equipped with intercom and security gate access, providing privacy and safety. Accessible by both elevator and walk-up options, this residence caters to various lifestyle needs. A large assigned storage room accessible from the sidewalk accommodates bike storage, too. Vibrant Fillmore Street offers cafes, restaurants, boutiques, and markets right out your doorstep and with Alta Plaza Park and transit one block away, the home is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated urban lifestyle.
